descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Welcome to Bodian's Bay Wash - a relaxing cleaning simulator with tycoon 
elements. Find peace at the bottom of the sea while doing the dirty work 
and building a wash station of your own.

🧼 Satisfying Manual Labor
Feel the reward of a job well done with your own hands.
[media]
[media]
 Blast fine grime with the water gun, then pry off stubborn barnacles with your scraper. Master your tools and leave everything spotless.

💰 Invest in Your Business
Every job pays. Spend your earnings on furniture, upgrades and better 
gear. A well-equipped station attracts higher-paying clients and unlocks 
technology that makes the work easier.

🐋 Clients of Every Size
No two days are alike down here. Start with small motorboats and harmless 
rafts. Expand your station, buy new licenses, and the ocean starts sending 
stranger work.

Some clients need a very long scrub. Others you'd rather not keep waiting.

📝 A note on scope
Bodian's Bay Wash is a 100% Brazilian indie game, built from scratch in 
four months. The whole team is one developer writing all the code and one 
concept artist bringing it to life. It's a short, focused game - and we're 
just getting started.
